profile_text.body:
Netflix Inc. describes itself as one of the world's leading entertainment services offering TV series, films, games and live programming across a wide variety of genres and languages. The company states that members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time. Netflix reports over 260 million paid memberships in over 190 countries.

SEC records identify Netflix Inc. as a for-profit public company with ticker NFLX, headquartered in Los Gatos, California, and CIK 0001065280. Public records list 281 legal matters in California involving the company.
